description: Receives requests of a REST route. The component subscribes to the topic of a web-API route and splits the incoming requests by HTTP method. A separate output connector is created for each method of the Methods property and a request is passed to the output connector of its method. The latest request is available via the Request reference.

properties.name: topic
properties.label: Route Topic
properties.description: Provide the name of the topic of the web-API route to subscribe to.

properties.name: methods
properties.label: Methods
properties.description: Provide the HTTP methods to handle (i.e. GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). A separate output connector is created for each method.
